Name: (CP) Shardust's Colorful and Pastel Craftables - Also with Decor options
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][u][b][size=5]2025 UPDATE

NOW WITH MORE RECOLORED ITEMS, PLUS PASTEL AND DECOR OPTIONS
[/size]
[size=4]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher and was tested with the latest STABLE (at the time of the upload) version of the game, SMAPI, and Content Patcher. [/size][/b][/u][size=4]

[size=4][u][b]Here's the Alternative Textures version:[/b][/u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11698](AT) Shardust's Colorful and Pastel Craftables[/url]﻿[/size]
[/size]
This a a series of recolors plus a pastel version and decor options for a selection of craftables and other assorted items.

The decor options consist of Snow Overlay in Winter, Foliage and Flowers decorations, and Seasonal Foliage for Vanilla Seasons only in the "Colorful" Versions.

Please refer to the image gallery for examples.

Colors available in the "Colorful" versions: Amethyst, Aquamarine, Ash, Blackberry, Coal, Cocoa, Cream, Diamond, Emerald, Goldenrod, Mahogany, Mocha, Oak, Olive, Ruby, Rust, Saffron, Sapphire, Spinel, Steel, Topaz, Umber, Walnut, Wine.

Colors available in the "Pastel" versions: Hazel, Honey, Lilac, Melon, Mint, Peach, Salt, Sugar.

Enjoy![/center]
